verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents installable generated clients for its Inference API across Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift via the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems, which replace hand-written HTTP calls. That client coverage is evidenced only for the Inference API. The CKS API and other services are documented only as raw APIs or through the Terraform provider, which is an infrastructure-as-code tool, not an SDK. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs covering CKS, networking, and storage; dedicated SDK documentation (install guides, versioning, examples); independent or hands-on corroboration of the clients' quality.
